name: Resolume Arena
hint: a column number (3), layer/clip (2/5), or an address from Resolume's OSC Shortcut mode (/composition/...)

rules.source: Resolume's OSC Shortcut mode shows each control's own address; the integer 1 is what community sources send
a Workcad manual shows the exact column packet with integer 1; not a Resolume page

notes: Any other address can be used by giving it in full.
